chunks: Mansur ibn Hazim narrated from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"My father (peace be upon him) fell ill on the Day of Eid al-Adha, so he prayed two rak'ahs in his house, then offered the sacrifice."
ai.seo_question: How did the Imams perform the Eid prayer when they were ill or at home?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the flexibility in Eid al-Adha observances, where Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) performed a concise two-rak'ah prayer at home due to illness, followed by the sacrifice. It underscores the Shia scholarly view that the Eid prayer is not strictly bound to a large congregation or specific location, allowing for individual performance when circumstances like illness prevent attendance at the main prayer ground.
